Info

Factory service constructing StreamExecutionWorker background workers.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.streamer.stream_execution_worker_factory.StreamExecutionWorkerFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing creation of StreamExecutionWorker instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Constructs StreamExecutionWorker with internal default formatter.
create_with_formatter - Constructs StreamExecutionWorker with explicit formatter.
classmethod create(*, flow_controller: FlowController, send_command: Callable[[str], bool], notify_progress: Callable[[str], None], notify_log: Callable[[str, bool], None], on_state_change: Callable[[StreamState], None], send_delay: float = 0.01, throttle_delay: float = 0.02, poll_delay: float = 0.05) → StreamExecutionWorker[source]¶

Constructs and returns a configured StreamExecutionWorker instance.

Parameters:

  • flow_controller – FlowController instance.

  • send_command – Callable transmitting raw command string.

  • notify_progress – Callable emitting progress notifications.

  • notify_log – Callable logging communication messages.

  • on_state_change – Callable updating streamer state enum.

  • send_delay – Pacing delay after transmit in seconds (default 0.01).

  • throttle_delay – Throttle backoff delay in seconds (default 0.02).

  • poll_delay – Polling interval in seconds (default 0.05).

Returns:

StreamExecutionWorker instance.

Constructs and returns a configured StreamExecutionWorker with injected formatter.

Parameters:

  • flow_controller – FlowController instance.

  • formatter – ICommandFormatter instance.

  • send_command – Callable transmitting raw command string.

  • notify_progress – Callable emitting progress notifications.

  • notify_log – Callable logging communication messages.

  • on_state_change – Callable updating streamer state enum.

  • send_delay – Pacing delay after transmit in seconds (default 0.01).

  • throttle_delay – Throttle backoff delay in seconds (default 0.02).

  • poll_delay – Polling interval in seconds (default 0.05).

Returns:

StreamExecutionWorker instance.
